phase1_application_records.query: What is the return window for products directly distributed by Tiki Trading compared to marketplace partner sellers?
phase1_application_records.full_draft_text: Customers may request an exchange or return within 30 days for products directly distributed by Tiki Trading, or within 7 days for products from marketplace partner sellers on Tiki, starting from the date of successful delivery.

POL-RET-001:2.0.title: Tiki Standard Product Return and Exchange Policy and Conditions
POL-RET-001:2.0.content: Customers may request an exchange or return within 30 days (for products directly distributed by Tiki Trading) or within 7 days (for products from marketplace partner sellers on Tiki) from the date of successful delivery. Returned products must have intact security seals, complete original packaging, accessories, invoices, and included promotional gifts, and show no signs of usage or laundering.

POL-RET-002:2.0.title: Return and Exchange Request Process and Steps on Tiki App
POL-RET-002:2.0.content: To create a return or exchange request, customers navigate to 'Account' > 'Order Management' > select the order with 'Delivered' status > tap 'Request Return/Exchange'. Customers select the reason and upload 3-5 clear photos or a video demonstrating the product defect. Once the request is received by Tiki, shipping couriers will pick up the item directly from the customer's address for free within 1-2 business days, or customers may drop off the package at designated Tiki partner post offices.

POL-RET-003:2.0.title: Restricted Return Categories and Non-Returnable Change-of-Mind Items on Tiki
POL-RET-003:2.0.content: Product categories that do not support returns due to change of mind or personal preference include: Underwear, swimwear, cosmetics and chemicals with unsealed protective packaging, Tiki Ngon fresh groceries, dietary supplements, mobile top-up scratch cards, electronic service vouchers, and clearance outlet items marked as non-returnable. These items are only eligible for return or exchange if Tiki delivered an incorrect item or if there is a verified manufacturer defect.

POL-REFUND-002:2.0.title: Refund Receipt Timeline by Payment Method on Tiki
POL-REFUND-002:2.0.content: The timeline for receiving a refund on Tiki depends on the original payment method: For Tiki Coins Wallet, refunds are credited within 24 hours. If the order remains unconfirmed after 1 hour, the system will automatically refund the original payment account within 24-72 business hours.

POL-RET-002:2.0.title: Return and Exchange Request Process and Steps on Tiki App
POL-RET-002:2.0.content: To create a return or exchange request, customers navigate to 'Account' > 'Order Management' > select the order with 'Delivered' status > tap 'Request Return/Exchange'. Customers select the reason and upload 3-5 clear photos or a video demonstrating the product defect. Once the request is received by Tiki, shipping couriers will pick up the item directly from the customer's address for free within 1-2 business days, or customers may drop off the package at designated Tiki partner post offices.

POL-REFUND-007:1.0.title: Checking Refund History and Order Status on Tiki
POL-REFUND-007:1.0.content: Customers can monitor refund progress by accessing 'Account Details' > 'Return & Refund Management'. Refund statuses include: 'Reconciliation Processing' (under customer support review), 'Transferred to Bank' (funds dispatched from Tiki, awaiting bank credit), and 'Refund Succeeded' along with the bank's transaction tracing reference code.

POL-SHIP-004:1.0.title: Handling Delayed, Lost, or Discrepant Delivery Statuses
POL-SHIP-004:1.0.content: In the event a Tiki order exceeds its estimated delivery date without arrival, or if a courier marks an order as 'Successfully Delivered' when the customer has not received the parcel, the customer must contact Tiki Customer Support within 24-48 hours via hotline 1900 6035. Tiki's dispatch team will verify courier GPS logs, coordinate with the delivery hub, and resolve the complaint. If an order is lost, Tiki will dispatch a replacement or issue a 100% refund.

POL-ORD-002:1.0.title: Order Cancellation Rules and Conditions on Tiki
POL-ORD-002:1.0.content: Customers can click 'Cancel Order' directly on the Tiki app if the order is in 'Processing' or 'Awaiting Packing' status and has not yet been handed over to the shipping carrier. For canceled prepaid orders, refunds will be issued automatically according to Tiki refund policies.

POL-RET-003:2.0.title: Restricted Return Categories and Non-Returnable Change-of-Mind Items on Tiki
POL-RET-003:2.0.content: Product categories that do not support returns due to change of mind or personal preference include: Underwear, swimwear, cosmetics and chemicals with unsealed protective packaging, Tiki Ngon fresh groceries, dietary supplements, mobile top-up scratch cards, electronic service vouchers, and clearance outlet items marked as non-returnable. These items are only eligible for return or exchange if Tiki delivered an incorrect item or if there is a verified manufacturer defect.

POL-PAY-001:1.0.title: Handling Payment Incidents and Banking Transactions on Tiki
POL-PAY-001:1.0.content: If a customer's bank account or e-wallet is debited but the order on Tiki remains in 'Awaiting Payment' status or fails to display, this is typically due to transmission latency from the payment gateway. The Tiki system and payment gateway automatically reconcile and update the order within 15-30 minutes. If the order remains unconfirmed after 1 hour, the system will automatically refund the original payment account within 24-72 business hours.

POL-PAY-004:1.0.title: Handling Double Deductions on Credit Cards or E-Wallets
POL-PAY-004:1.0.content: In instances where network congestion causes a transaction to be recorded and charged twice for the same Tiki order code, Tiki's automated reconciliation system and partner banks will detect the duplicate charge during end-of-day settlement and refund the excess amount to the card within 48 business hours without requiring a formal dispute claim.
